-- in --
package main

templ test() {
	<p><b>one</b> <i>two</i> <em>three</em> <strong>four</strong> <code>five</code> <small>six</small> <mark>seven</mark></p>
}
-- out --
package main

templ test() {
	<p>
		<b>one</b> <i>two</i> <em>three</em> <strong>four</strong> <code>five</code>
		<small>six</small> <mark>seven</mark>
	</p>
}
